fields.independent_source_first_note: Complete Hindi read. Jabir’s father-debt/crop-refusal, Prophet visit/blessing, exact thirteen-wasq residue with unresolved seven/six OR reversal, Maghrib encounter and Abu Bakr/Umar response are supplied actual report. Preserve the current-year-date crop restriction and the parenthetic tell-me command completing the when-clause; the mirbad drying-place definition is lexical context. The later Hisham Asr mention, omissions and Ibn Ishaq Dhuhr mention are route/version-comparison apparatus, but the explicitly introduced Jabir first-person father-left-thirty-wasq sentence is a finite actual variant and must be retained under that qualified voice. No timing harmonization or quantity choice.

Jabir’s payment miracle, uncertain six/seven division, Maghrib visit and the two Companions’ own response remain. The appended Hisham/Asr, absent Abu Bakr/laughter and Ibn Ishaq/Zuhr comparisons do not themselves supply those omitted narratives. The parenthetically named Jabir thirty-wasq debt clause is nevertheless finite transmitted content, separately voiced within this report. Preserve all source number/time differences.

Complete Urdu read. Jarir’s own pledge and the Messenger’s goodwill-to-every-Muslim stipulation are finite content in the final hearing/report frame. Separate the multistep preliminary route without removing the actual subject, pledge or all-Muslim domain.

Complete Urdu read. The three named pledge conditions and Jarir’s first-person relation to the Messenger remain exactly supplied. Prefatory transmitter list is context, while the final reporter and all domain qualifiers remain.

Complete long Hindi field read. Jabir’s tired camel, Prophet strike/prayer, purchase, refusal then assent, home-riding reservation, Medina arrival/payment/call-back, gift and explicit no-price-recovery action form the actual first narrative. The campaign occasion, Medina destination and I-returned encounter parentheses supply circumstances, not redundant dictionary words. Later explicit finite permission/condition/purchase clauses survive independently of their pure multistep routes: permission to Medina, own sale-on-condition, your riding to Medina, the personal riding condition, stay on it, permission, ride home, one-ounce purchase, quoted four-dinar purchase, Tabuk-return purchase with qualified I-think four-ounce uncertainty, and twenty-dinar purchase. Preserve real parenthetic speaker links and actual purchased predicates. The one-dinar/ten-dirham conversion, mere mutabaah/omission statements, nominal gold/two-hundred price descriptions without an actual supplied transaction predicate, and final compiler preference/authenticity appraisal are context. Do not choose among amounts or turn unnamed material doubt into a settled Prophet statement.

Complete long Urdu independently read. All first-story acts and restrictions are supplied, including the actual parenthetic no-return-of-price statement, Medina and return-to-presence. Distinguish every actual later finite riding/sale/permission/purchase wording from chain-only and metalinguistic comparisons. Parenthetic Messenger/Jabir attribution and the final purchased predicate are meaningful. Actual four-dinar wording and the Tabuk-return purchase with uncertain four-ounce recollection remain, without unit-conversion prose or compiler preference turning into quoted speech. The nominal one-ounce-gold and two-hundred-dirham comparisons are source apparatus; actual Abu Nadrah/Jabir twenty-dinar purchase is finite. Different source spellings, counts and unknown I-think voice remain unharmonized.

The brothers’ Muhajirin apposition is a repeated identity label with the group explicitly named later; its removal as context does not remove the group from the actual encounter. Keep the complete proposal, no-answer, arrangement and acceptance, separating the preliminary route.

Do not lose the actual need/customary/no-blame qualifiers in the preceding report.

Preserve the real original restriction against accumulation in visible context without assigning it to the Prophet.
